:::{#rem-squared-error-loss}
#### Squared-error loss

Each error defined below holds for any [loss](#def-observation-loss).
The examples, exercises and the bias-variance decomposition use *squared-error loss*,
$\lossf{\outvar, \hat{\outvar}} = \sqf{\hat{\outvar} - \outvar}$,
unless they say otherwise.
Then the loss on an observation is the square of its [prediction error](prediction.qmd#def-prediction-error),
$\obsloss{\iobs} = \prederr_{\iobs}^2$,
and each average loss below is a sample mean squared error.

:::
